title: Schools attended and New Orleans University
summary: He recounts his elementary schools, a year at New Orleans University, its president, and the vocal music teacher.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school
